title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1976-06-29
taper: Betty Cantor, provided by Rich Gastwirt
source: Source Info: 7" two track Betty reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT; Transfer Info: DAT(Sony PCM-R500)-> Tascam DA-3000-> Adobe Audition-> TLH flac16; Transfer by Charlie Miller; Mastered by Scott Clugston

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy June ’76 show, praised for top‑tier audio and vibrant performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers highlight the Betty Board source as crystal‑clear and among the best recordings in the archive, noting the show’s high energy and superb setlist. The performance is described as a standout June concert with an irresistible vibe, while no specific song or band‑member issues are mentioned. Overall the recording is deemed flawless and the music exhilarating.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance and the Betty soundboard quality; no significant criticisms were found.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Betty Board capture described as crystal‑clear, high‑fidelity and among the best in the archive; no dropouts or mix issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, amazing set list with a strong June vibe; reviewers recommend listening for its overall excitement rather than specific song highlights.
